bestBets.overview: Taree was rated Heavy 8 as acceptances were taken on Thursday but that was after rain came through Tuesday night and Wednesday. It looks as though we've seen the last of rain for a little while though so we should expect plenty of improvement, back into Soft for sure and maybe even threatening a Good 4 by Monday afternoon. (Hey, it's nearly spring, I'm allowed to be hopeful.) Soft 6 is where we kick off on race morning. The meeting kicks off with a 1000m Maiden and we have two newcomers here. MADAME REBEL had one back in January - a 7L 3rd/6 then reappeared in mid July for another. Led the way but faded to 5th of 6, beaten 3L. PLOUGHMAN has had just the one, recently at Grafton. Settled midfield and finished 7L 7th of 8. WILD MONARCH placed in both first prep starts. Was a lacklustre 5th of 6 in one recent trial but the winner dominated that and is a Saturday horse. Golly he's short though.

raceTips.comment: Thin maiden and not a race I'd be diving into from a betting perspective. Wild Monarch placed in both runs last prep in handy enough form races. Deserving of favouritism, but is very skinny in betting. Kanmuru resumes off a long spell but has been gelded and shown glimpses of ability in the past. Fabulous One was pushed out and responded well to win a recent trial. Local hope Last Metaphor ran a vastly improved race at track/trip last time.

bestBets.overview: 1 and 2 have other options. CREATIVE RIGHTEOUS has switched up from Victoria and has evidently enjoyed the change. Has a lot more weight to deal with today but so do others. BELLEVUE is down in class but 63 kilos is the payoff. His two wins have come for Anna Roper and she has only ridden him those two times. DAMASCUS GATE could end up with a nice easy lead.

raceTips.comment: Bellevue has to lump 63kg but looks hard to beat in this grade, especially with Anna Roper aboard who is 2/2 on him. He sets up for a gun run throughout. Damascus Gate smartly engages a claimer to offset a big weight impost and can lead throughout and prove hard to run down. Yorikiri is always a genuine hope in these races. Creative Righteous backs up quickly after notching up another win last time out.

bestBets.overview: 4, 8, 10, 12, 13 are dual acceptors here so we will have a firmer idea once we know where they are going. Pace - as it stands - from 12 and 6 ahead of 10. WOODROW draws widest but will get up and over. Extending out to 1600m after just a steady finish last start at seven furlongs is the big question but scratchings here - and a likely easy tempo - present him with a race he should be in the finish of. GEMTIKI is more proven at the trip and she probably has to roll forward from her draw as well.

raceTips.comment: Smichov ran and won yesterday so plan B. Gemtiki was heavily supported the moment prices went live and understandably so. Woodrow comes via handy form races but might have to work for the lead and is unknown at the back end of this distance range. The Comanche and What A Gent get promoted into numbers owing to scratchings.

bestBets.overview: 3, 15, 16 come out. 6, 13, 14 still dual acceptors at preview time. RIVER JORDAN returns after a one start initial prep and has had two encouraging recent trials, settling outside the leader in both. Scratchings here probably deliver him the front position. No doubt ALABAMA CHARM is a danger but she may be settling right out the back. Two newcomers - ALMAS JEWEL has run on quite well to place 3rd in two recent trials and the leader has won both of those hitouts. SU MISURA has also had two in August and also finished both of those reasonably.

raceTips.comment: Hello G'Day was solid on debut in a race that has already produced subsequent winning form. She maps to be awarded every chance. River Jordan resumes for a second prep notably with Christian Reith in the saddle who rides here. He was heavily supported on debut last prep in a handy form reference race. Alabama Charm got too far back when resuming but strips fitter and will appreciate the longer trip. Sylvan wasn't beaten all that far on debut and will have derived benefit from the run.

bestBets.overview: 7 and 5 to lead 3 and 11. THE CRISTAL waits for Scone on Tuesday it seems. In her absence EXORBITANT MISS is going to be favoured to notch a hat-trick. She'll be back off the speed again no doubt but she was very strong here last time and she is simply a little up in grade and a little down in weight. JUST SHANE and MR VILLA likely to settle top three in running and they both ought to kick on into the finish quite well. BELLA KATHLEEN - probable leader? - can do similar.

raceTips.comment: Just Shane lumps an extra 4kg from last start owing to the class drop but it looks a nice race for him. Concede he does tend to mix form, but best efforts are right up to this. Exorbitant Miss is chasing a hat-trick and has been subject to early market support. No Knock. Bella Kathleen next.

She performed exactly as expected in Saturday company two back but on either side are performances that would go a long way to winning this. Finds gun run as well? First-upper CHESTIME comes back after a trial win at Muswellbrook on August 19th. Came from a clear last to have last say in that 1000m hitout and you can imagine something similar unfolding here.

raceTips.comment: Deebee's Girl appeals at the price. Tends to race well here and is ideally drawn for a soft on speed run. Josephine was well supported last start and sets up as the map horse of the race. She looks ideally suited dropping back a touch in distance. Chestime has trialled well leading into the prep, is a distance specialist and has a good affiliation with the jockey. Russian Escape next.

Rider conceded that, in hindsight, he should have made a greater effort to restrain the mare during the middle stages. Trainer confirmed the instructions.

A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to be recovering slowly. Trainer advised the mare would undergo a stable veterinary inspection. Vet no abs.

bestBets.overview: 1, 3, 8 to set the tempo and all are winning hopes. SATIN AND CASH hasn'exactly been an on-pcaer so far but she gets a barrier and opposition here that could see her setting up perfectly in the run. Back from a 1600m tilt last start, she has maintained consistent form throughout what is now a fairly lengthy prep. PURPLE ROSE messed up the start and really struggled last start but you hope she can revert to her previous approach which worked to winning effect at Muswellbrook.

raceTips.comment: Satin And Cash looks hard to beat coming back in distance in which she is 2/3. She can utilise the inside draw and provided a gap opens at the right time, she will be hard to beat. Purple Rose sets up well from a mapping point of view and can sharply improve here after an average run last time. Broadway Follies is a long time between wins but wouldn't surprise in this line up. Star Prediction next.

bestBets.overview: Plenty of pace in the last. CITY GOLD SPEED draws nicely to camp just off the main pace and perhaps have last say, even though his 1 from 16 record suggests an each-way bet would be wisest. Handles all conditions no problem. YES YES BOSS can set up with a perfect trail whoever ends up leading the way. She had a very busy and lengthy prep last time around now finds herself returning in new hands and without a recent public trial to help us know how she's going.

raceTips.comment: Lensman has a tough draw to contend with but appeals resuming off a trial win in this weaker jurisdiction. He may find this trip a little sharp on prior form, but at the odds I can't go past him. Stormfield sets up to lead from a low draw and gets weight relief with a claimer on. Difensivo is hard-fit but another who has a tricky draw to contend with. Yes Yes Boss went to the paddock on a high and should get a soft on speed run from the draw.
